units: CSS px of the sheet, y down; box = [l, t, r, b]
note: Each step is one layout call: list (or {ref: step} = the list of an earlier step), view, paint, memory (before the call; null = none) and what the client solver returned: every label after the call (x, y, box), the memory (k of each placed label) and the stats.

steps.note: segment with memory: stays at p0
same frame: nothing evaluated, nothing moved
anchor moved < ANCHOR_EPS: kept, not evaluated
N, one octant off: 1.17 vs 1.00, gain 14.5 % < 25 % — stays
NW, two octants off: 1.32 vs 1.00, gain 24.2 % < 25 % — stays
SW, four octants off: 1.62 vs 1.00, gain 38.3 % — moves
still but previous place overlaps a point
k out of range → fresh; vanished id dropped
